records.title: Superposed Latent Autoencoder
records.reason: SLAE is an autoencoder latent-memory compression method evaluated on image datasets, not LLM inference.

records.title: FinLifeBench: Exhaustive Life-Event History and Financial-State Reconstruction from Longitudinal Banking Dialogue
records.reason: FinLifeBench measures longitudinal dialogue memory/recall under full context; it is a benchmark, not inference-time compression or efficiency.

records.title: Multi-Head Self Attention is a Parameter Identification Mechanism
records.reason: The work studies attention identifiability and notes possible model-size implications, but explicitly provides no evidence for adopting its update intervention or inference efficiency.

records.title: A Composable Evaluation System for Reproducible Omni-Modal Foundation Model Evaluation
records.reason: OmniEvaluator is evaluation infrastructure that composes existing inference/evaluation engines; its contribution is reproducible benchmarking, not optimization of LLM serving. The CPU verifier reduces evaluator API expense only.

records.title: Bandits in Prod: Hyperparameter Optimization at Inference Time
records.reason: Weak scope fit: current experiments do not optimize or report inference cost/latency; the paper explicitly leaves cost/latency-constrained objectives for future work.
